notes.title: Demo Update & Release Date Details
notes.notes:
New Demo Update
We have recently updated our demo with a partch that represents a very close to finished version of the game.



However, due to some technical issues, we have decided to remove the "Parking" Demo. The older version will still be available as a "beta" on the games properties on your steam library.




Release Date Details
We originally planned our release date for May 23rd, however, there's a chance you may already know that we recently announced on our socials that the game has been delayed, and that the new release date is June 24th, 2025. We hope you understand.



Thank y'all for the support, and see you very soon!



Known issues:

[strike]We know there's a bug where, if you get killed by The Priest during the demo, the door needed go end the level won't open. We are already working on a fix and should ship tomorrow![/strike]   <Fixed

notes.title: Demo Hotfix #2

Known Issues:

notes.title: Known Issues and Halloween Update Delay
notes.notes:
Halloween Update Delay

Hello! We wanted to make this quick post to tell all of you that the Halloween Demo Updated we planned for October 31st will be available on November 8th instead. We found some serious technical issues that need to be resolved before we can make it public, and to polish it out as much as we can to match our quality standards.


Slow Loading Screens Issue

Additionally, we wanted to let you know that we are aware of the issue that some people have with the Demo where the loading screen may take a serious amount of time to load the level (Normally taking around 2 or 5 minutes which is extremely abnormal). We are investigating the issue and have a potential solution while we try to fix it:

First, it seems that the issue is mainly affected by those who have the game installed on HDD Disks, so we encourage to move the install of the game to a SSD Disk instead if possible. We will be trying to optimize ther loading of the levels as much as we can so this isn't needed, however we still encourage players to use and SSD Disk since it's overall much more effective than an HDD Disk.

If you find any other issues, please report them on our Discord Server.

In the meantime, we have dropped a small patch with a small warning of loading issue and the Demo Selector that will be fully available on November 8th when we release "The Parking" Demo.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063930/c2f4be024e85b22259c9b8002855b7466e369d71.png

Thank you for your patience and see you soon!

notes.title: Prologue Demo Updated & Halloween Update Announcement
notes.notes:
New Trailer

We released a new trailer! Go watch it if you haven't!

[previewyoutube=0gIwiFD5av0;full][/previewyoutube]

Demo Update for Steam Next Fest

We recently updated our demo with a very close to final build of the Prologue. This version includes entire new systems like the Inventory, reworked notes, reworked Player Movement, reworked cinematics, among others.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063930/5de0b8901f94f7e85e5459f94f23e789cc7c0d53.jpg

This was mainly done because we are taking part of the "Steam Next Fest" event and we want our players to have a better experience when trying the demo.

Here's the entire Changelog:

Main Menu
- Changed the entire UI Layout of the menu, improving the visuals.

- Changed the Main Menu music.

- Added the "Enable V-sync" option in the options menu.

- Included an "Add to Wishlist" button.

- Slightly modified the credits layout.

Player Systems
- Added a new movement system, where you can now actually see your character.

- Added the new Inventory System, where you can pick up items and notes and see them on your 
inventory. Now when you read a Note, you can read them again on the "NOTES" section in your inventory anywhere. Keep in mind the UI for this system is not final and it will change.

- You can now enable/disable the VHS Effect on the prologue by pressing the "V" key.

- Improved some UI elements.

Miscellaneous
- Removed the controls in the loading screen, now they show up after the new starting cinematic.

- Improved various cinematics and events, forcing the player in some instances to look at certain things so they can't miss it.

- Potential fixes to achievements not working

Among others.


Halloween Update coming soon!

On October 31st, we will be releasing a new (and possibly final) update to our demo, adding a whole new "level" to it. This section will be of the second chapter of the game, "The Parking", with the intent of showing the new and improved Enemy AI and the new hiding mechanics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063930/c6d7609461594ec98403936b1db140aad2dd08f3.jpg
You may have seen some of this already if you watched our latest trailer...

That's all!
We hope you have enjoyed this small Devblog!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45063930/84ff79f3405f2c93af4dea8bc495228308a53113.png
See you in the next DevBlog!
